label: Daggerfall Unity sandboxes
description: How Daggerfall Unity sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: Mods are switched on in the game's Mod List screen after deploying.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.
